create_NYU_dataset_train: create an NYU dataset instance using the train split with a specified root directory
create_NYU_dataset_val: create an NYU dataset instance using the val split with custom image and target decoders
get_image_data_by_index: get the raw image bytes for a sample at a given index from the NYU dataset

review_NYU_Split_enum: review the _Split enum that maps train, val, and test splits to their data file names
